role: Monitors outbound data flows for exfiltration risk: flags any flow to a non-allowlisted destination outright, and separately flags an unusually large transfer to a known destination via real statistical baseline deviation (reusing D-07's z-score logic rather than duplicating it).
behaviorDescription: monitorOutboundFlows() checks each outbound flow against a destination allowlist configured on the bot; any non-allowlisted destination is flagged (block severity) regardless of transfer size, since a small quiet exfiltration to a new destination would never look anomalous by volume alone. For allowlisted destinations, if a volume baseline is supplied, the actual transfer size is scored via D-07's real, reused computeBaseline()/scoreAgainstBaseline() functions — not reimplemented — flagging a volume anomaly (crit severity) when it exceeds the threshold. A flow already flagged for its destination is not also volume-checked, avoiding double-counting.
hardStops: Never flags a flow twice for the same finding — a non-allowlisted destination is not also volume-checked
Reuses D-07's exact z-score functions rather than reimplementing baseline-deviation math independently
Never treats volume within statistical norms as sufficient — an unrecognized destination is flagged regardless of transfer size
